market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver's all‑time high is ~$50 (1980 and 2011); reaching $120 would more than double that record. Such an extreme move would require a catastrophic economic shock or hyperinflation, events with minuscule probability over the next year. The market’s 6.8% implied chance is an order of magnitude too high.
evidence_points: All‑time high settlement for silver futures is $48.70 (2011); intraday high $49.45 (1980).
Current silver price is ~$30–35, so a jump to $120 represents a 3–4× increase in roughly one year.
There are no plausible supply/demand or monetary catalysts sufficient to drive such a move in this timeframe.
